class.name: GodotDoctorReport
class.brief_description: Base class for all Godot Doctor report types. Provides shared utilities for counting and filtering validation messages by severity.

method.name: _get_num_infos
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.INFO]-level messages from [param validation_messages].

method.name: _get_num_warnings
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]-level messages from [param validation_messages].

method.name: _get_num_errors
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR]-level messages from [param validation_messages].

method.name: _filter_by_severity_level
method.description: Returns messages from [param validation_messages] that match the given [param severity].
